title: MOReL: Model-Based Offline Reinforcement Learning

methods.one_paragraph_description: Two steps: (a) learn a pessimistic MDP (P-MDP) from the offline dataset using an ensemble of Gaussian MLP dynamics models; an unknown state-action detector (USAD) flags (s,a) as unknown when ensemble discrepancy disc(s,a)=max_{i,j}||f_i(s,a)-f_j(s,a)||_2 exceeds a threshold, and such transitions go to an absorbing HALT state with reward -kappa; (b) learn a policy (tanh MLP) in the P-MDP with model-based natural policy gradient (NPG). Performance in the real environment is approximately lower-bounded by performance in the P-MDP.
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: model-based offline RL (paper: 'we present MOReL, an algorithmic framework for model-based offline RL')

problems: Hyperparameters in Tables 4 and 5 are stated per gym environment for the Wu et al. (2019) datasets (Pure/Eps/Gauss); the paper never states separate hyperparameters for the D4RL runs. Per-dataset conditions above copy the per-environment values and should be treated as the best available, not confirmed D4RL settings.
The USAD threshold beta and the negative-reward offset are searched per setting but the chosen values are not reported.
Table 2 has no std / confidence interval.
Seed count is inconsistent: Table 2 caption says 3 seeds for D4RL; main text (Section 5, Appendix C.1) says 5 seeds for the Wu et al. datasets.
Table 7 (discrepancy threshold ablation) is on a non-D4RL Hopper-v2 dataset and reports raw returns; not extracted as rows.
